name: VTSwapHook
rootCause: Pricing Error in UniswapV4 Hook. Lost: 4,507,034.03 vATH + 2,007,935.14 ATH

descriptions.text: Pricing Error in UniswapV4 Hook. Lost: 4,507,034.03 vATH + 2,007,935.14 ATH

On March 28, 2026, the VTSwapHook contract on Arbitrum was exploited through a pricing and accounting flaw in its custom Uniswap v4 hook, allowing an attacker to drain the pool of approximately 2 million ATH and 4.5 million vATH. The exploit abused a midpoint price approximation and reserve inflation bug, resulting in substantial loss to liquidity providers. The exploit arose from two compounding bugs in the VTSwapHook custom Uniswap v4 hook: (1) a midpoint approximation that systematically overestimated swap output on a nonlinear logarithmic curve, and (2) improper reserve updates that credited the pool's reserves with pre-fee gross input, inflating state and further distorting pricing.
